d: Brand new music from Mark Giuliano! (words below) A raw, haunting fusion of cinematic rock and dark pop, "You Were Gone" couples heavy, lush vocals, with a soaring cello solo, and deeply atmospheric narrative. Produced by Dove Award winner and Grammy nominee Kim McLean alongside an A-list team of Nashville session musicians, the track was recorded at the iconic Sound Emporium Studios, engineered by Grammy-winner Steve Marcantonio, and mastered at Georgetown Masters.
